reviewScope: Independent design-contract review only. This verdict does not mark DR-103 SATISFIED, does not qualify or demonstrate anything, and does not authorize implementation.
summary: The lockSchema clauses now defer every lock to DR-111, but that deferral was not propagated to unconditional lock-bearing corpus requirements. The v5 source-custody repair also leaves contradictory unversioned authoring-measurement claims.

blockers.title: The no-lock-until-DR-111 rule conflicts with still-required lock fixtures
blockers.detail: testCorpusRequirements.discipline makes every listed class a requirement and requires every fixture to have an ACCEPT outcome or exactly one refusal. TC-ACCEPT now says that no lock fixture is required or producible until DR-111, matching lockSchema.resolutionInputs and ID-DEP-4. But TC-BYTE-EXACT still unconditionally requires a fixture whose admission digest, index custody digest, and lock digest all recompute from stored bytes, and TC-SIG still unconditionally requires an artifact-bytes-versus-lock-digest mismatch fixture. Neither member carries the DR-111 gate. The first requires a usable lock-bearing exact-byte fixture while the contract says no lock fixture can exist; the second cannot isolate its promised one-refusal outcome against a lock form whose compatibility resolution is not yet producible. The v4 blocker repair therefore remains internally inconsistent outside TC-ACCEPT.
blockers.requiredRepair: Propagate the DR-111 conditional to every lock-bearing corpus member, including TC-SIG and TC-BYTE-EXACT, and state that those fixtures enter only after DR-111 closes. If a pre-DR-111 custody fixture is intended, give it a non-lock carrier and a non-lock expected outcome.

shouldFix.title: V4-S2 custody accounting remains contradictory after reMeasurementAtV5
shouldFix.detail: sources.reMeasurementAtV5 explicitly scopes only corpusHeadAtAuthoring and reMeasurementAtV2 as v2-era and disclaims remeasurement of moved SRC-08, SRC-D, and SRC-FRZ pins. The unchanged bindingSources entries nevertheless still say measuredAtAuthoring: true for every source, and citationDiscipline still says all whole-document digests above are measured at authoring. At v5 review, the three recorded pins do not match the live bytes: SRC-08 records f0d72536... but is 1cdcf9d4...; SRC-D records a3d0d266... but is 12d192f7...; SRC-FRZ records 93a4f74f... but is e809d439.... The added caveat and the unversioned positive claims cannot both describe v5 authoring. This is the same half-repaired successor-custody defect V4-S2 identified.
shouldFix.requiredRepair: Version-scope the inherited per-source flags and citationDiscipline explicitly to v2 authoring, or remeasure and replace the v5 pins. Keep the named-property live re-verification separate from whole-document digest custody.

advisories.title: The basedOn method should not imply an in-place future Claude fold
advisories.detail: basedOn.method says that future Claude v4 findings may be folded after that verdict lands, while appliesFindingsOf.claude2V4 freezes the verdict as NOT-RECEIVED and no such file exists. A later verdict would require a new digest-pinned successor rather than mutation of v5. Removing the future-fold phrase would make the frozen lineage unambiguous.
